# Cariyāpiṭaka-aṭṭhakathā (Atk S0512a)

**ID:** Atk S0512a
**Section:** Aṭṭhakathā Khuddakanikāya (atk-s05)
**Collection:** Atthakatha-Suttas
**Title (Pali):** Cariyāpiṭaka-aṭṭhakathā
**tipitaka.org (CST):** https://tipitaka.org/romn/

## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature and SuttaCentral)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and SuttaCentral data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

The *Cariyāpiṭaka-aṭṭhakathā*, titled *Paramatthadīpanī*, is the commentary on the canonical *Cariyāpiṭaka* of the Khuddakanikāya [Norman 1983; Adikaram 1946]. Attributed to Ācariya Dhammapāla as part of his *Paramatthadīpanī* commentarial corpus, the text was edited for modern scholarship by D. L. Barua [von Hinüber 1996; Endo 1997]. Among commentarial works, it is uniquely valuable for providing detailed expositions of cosmic time units such as the *kappa*, *asaṅkheyya*, and *mahākappa* [Endo 2002]. It also cites the ten perfections as *buddhakāraka-dhammā* traditionally counted as canonical authority [Endo 1997].

A central doctrinal contribution of the work is found in its concluding miscellaneous section (*Pakiṇṇaka-kathā*), where Dhammapāla incorporated his "Treatise on the Pāramīs" [War Yar Mein Da 2015; Bodhi]. Intended for practitioners following the suttas who engage in the path to great enlightenment, this treatise presents a systematic Theravāda articulation of the bodhisattva path, harmonizing the list of ten perfections with alternative classifications into six, and detailing subdivisions such as the threefold gift of material things (*āmisadāna*), fearlessness (*abhayadāna*), and Dhamma (*dhammadāna*) [Bodhi; Schlosser 2016]. An abridged version of this treatise is preserved in the subcommentary (*ṭīkā*) to the *Brahmajāla Sutta* [Bodhi; Schlosser 2016].

Text-reuse analysis in DharmaNexus identifies 25,892 matching passages shared between the *Cariyāpiṭaka-aṭṭhakathā* and 337 other Pali texts [DharmaNexus]. Its largest textual overlaps occur with the *Dīghanikāya* subcommentaries—sharing over 214,000 characters with the *Sīlakkhandhavagga-abhinavaṭīkā* and over 137,000 characters with the *Sīlakkhandhavaggaṭīkā*—substantiating the incorporation of the treatise on perfections across these works [DharmaNexus]. Extensive text reuse also connects it with all volumes of the *Jātaka-aṭṭhakathā*, the *Apadāna-aṭṭhakathā*, and the *Buddhavaṃsa-aṭṭhakathā* [DharmaNexus]. No cross-language matches meet the threshold of 10 [DharmaNexus].
